title: Scripted e2e drive (input injection + screenshot writes + forced exit) now ships in every build, armed solely by the PP_NOC_E2E env var
detail: Release binaries now carry the test-automation drive previously PP_DEBUG-compiled-out: any launch with PP_NOC_E2E set injects scripted D presses, writes bin/noc-e2e-*.png under cwd, and self-exits. Local-only boundary (offline game), so impact is a hijacked run, not remote compromise (CWE-489).
recommended_fix: Briefing accepts env-gated e2e in any build; if release hardening is wanted, re-gate only the noc_e2e blocks behind a define (leaving the panel runtime-gated) or strip them from Steam builds.
